content.outro: The street is walked, and the warden has seen every front and every fountain on it.
content.premise: The town warden walks Tanner's Row before the fair: the new smithy front, the fountain square, the old stall and the old well-yard, to judge which of them looks right.
content.theme: One short street with four places on it: a smithy whose front is a frame of posts and a beam, a square with a fountain whose water stands in a bowl raised on a stack over a basin, a stall with a door standing free beside its counter, and a yard with a flat ring round one cell of water.
content.title: The Front and the Fountain
